subject.title: Group chat context handling can blur which messages are addressed to the current agent

question: What permanent target-state contract should OpenClaw expose for multi-agent group history and reply context?
rationale: Adding per-message current-agent, other-bot, or ambient attribution changes the core prompt context and plugin/channel contract; automation should not choose the sibling-bot identity source or suppression semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve additive target metadata
options.body: Add optional target fields to history/reply context, have Telegram populate them first, and require tests plus live Telegram proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Use prompt-only mitigation for now
options.body: Keep the issue open but treat PRs like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78054 as temporary guidance rather than the final fix.

options.title: Defer to channel-specific follow-ups
options.body: Leave this issue as a canonical design discussion and handle Feishu, Telegram, and other channels through separate channel-owned items once the contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve additive target metadata
recommendation.body: Add optional target fields to history/reply context, have Telegram populate them first, and require tests plus live Telegram proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined history on group prompt behavior, inbound metadata, and product boundary decisions for this surface.
